def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    face_value = 1000
    current_rate = 0.08
    up_rate = 0.10
    down_rate = 0.06
    probability_up = 0.50
    probability_down = 0.50
    annual_duration_risk_premium = 0.004

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    expected_rate_after_one_year = (
        probability_up * up_rate + probability_down * down_rate
    )
    risk_adjusted_rate = expected_rate_after_one_year + annual_duration_risk_premium
    bond_value = face_value / ((1 + current_rate) * (1 + risk_adjusted_rate))

    # Return the answer rounded to three decimal places
    return round(bond_value, 3)
